Alger, 13 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 13, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Several hundred Nvidia employees are mobilizing internally to ask the board of directors for the return of co-founder Jensen Huang, who stepped down on November 12. Interim CEO duties are being handled by Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress.
Mobilisation interne et turbulences fina: Internal mobilization and financial turbulence at Nvidia
Selon des informations révélées par le m: According to information revealed by Wired magazine based on internal exchanges, a message posted in the company's suggestion box by a senior engineer generated more than 1,600 comments, mostly in favor of Jensen Huang's return. Another employee sent an email to all staff demanding transparency regarding this departure, which occurred 33 years after the group's founding, while about twenty employees showed their support on the social network LinkedIn.
Cette contestation survient dans un cont: This protest comes amid a backdrop of internal crisis. On Sunday, November 8, Jensen Huang admitted in an email that he had been unfaithful to his wife, before reports emerged on November 12 of a third alleged affair with an employee. Meanwhile, US lawmakers are demanding answers and the FBI is investigating Alice Huang, head of Megaspeed, who is suspected of working for Chinese intelligence. The former executive has agreed to testify behind closed doors before three House committees by November 26.
Sur le plan financier, l'entreprise amér: Financially, the American company has lost approximately $1,760 billion in market value since its record high on October 6, including nearly $500 billion during the scandal week alone. The board of directors, now chaired by Harvey C. Jones, had commissioned the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz on November 10 to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia has approximately 42,000 employees as of the end of January 2026.
